Circus Tent.name: Circus Tent
Circus Tent.description:
Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Phantasmic Circus

Space: Vast

Hirelings: 4

Order: Trade

The Circus Tent is a space for musical, acrobatic, comedic, or other performances intended to delight a crowd. The tent includes seating for audience members. Your hirelings are @UUID[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.actors.Actor.mmPerformer00000]{Performers} whose alignment matches your own. Assign names, personalities, and circus acts to them as you see fit.

Trade: Circus Performance. When you issue the Trade order to this facility, the facility’s hirelings turn the Circus Tent into a performance venue for 7 days. At the end of the seventh day, your portion of the proceeds is equal to [[/award 2d6*10gp]].

Heist Planning Chamber.description:
Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Ninth Quill

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Research

This room has a planning table, pieces of miniature terrain to represent walls or furniture, and tomes on magical security, architecture, and spy craft useful when planning a heist.

Research: Reconnaissance. When you issue the Research order to this facility, your hireling sends spies to evaluate a building within 50 miles of your Bastion. This work takes 7 days. At the end of the seventh day, the hireling provides a model of the building on the planning table. Public areas of the building are depicted accurately, and private areas are depicted only generally. Any area concealed by magic or protected by powerful guardians, at the DM’s discretion, might not be depicted accurately or at all. The spies avoid all creatures, so information about the building’s inhabitants is sparse.

The model remains until you use the Research order on this facility again, but it might become inaccurate over time if the building changes.

Heist Preparations. A character who prepares for a theft or infiltration using the model for at least 8 hours chooses one of the following roles. The role’s benefit applies while the character is within 1 mile of the building depicted by the model and lasts for 7 days or until you prepare again:

Enforcer: Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks

Face: Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks

Lookout: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks

Medic: Advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks

Sneak: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks

Thief: Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks

Enlarging the Facility. You can enlarge your Heist Planning Chamber to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the range of Reconnaissance increases to 500 miles, and a character preparing for a heist can choose two roles, gaining the benefits of both.
Heist Planning Chamber.name: Heist Planning Chamber

Geothermal Vent.name: Geothermal Vent

Heat Tolerant.description: When you take Fire damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce this damage by [[/r 1d4]] plus your level. This benefit lasts for 7 days.
Heat Tolerant.name: Heat Tolerant

Geothermal Vent.description:
Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Crucible Keepers

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Empower

A geothermal vent draws heat from deep below the surface to provide energy and power simple machines.

Empower: Withstand Heat. When you issue the Empower order to this facility, for the next 7 days, the facility’s hireling teaches a series of meditative techniques that allow a character to mitigate the injuries they suffer from flames. Any character who trains here for at least 8 hours on each of those days gains the following benefit at the end of the training period:

Heat Tolerant. When you take Fire damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce this damage by 1d4 plus your level. This benefit lasts for 7 days.

Hot Water. Your basic facilities benefit from a constant source of adjustable heat. For example, a dining room has a warming table to keep food hot, a kitchen has multiple ovens with varying heat, and a bedroom has a basin that warms water for washing.

Transmutation Vat.description:
Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Bringers of Cosmic Dawn

Space: Cramped

Hirelings: 1

Order: Harvest

This laboratory features a vat or cauldron simmering with transformation potential.

Harvest: Fluid Transmutation. When you issue the Harvest order to this facility, you instruct your hireling to pour a substance into the vat and transform it into something else. You must expend a Common or Uncommon potion, which is destroyed in the vat. At the end of 7 days, the hireling produces your choice of a flask of @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagAlchemistsF]{Alchemist’s Fire}, a vial of @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagAntitoxin00]{Antitoxin}, a vial of @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagPoisonBasic]{Basic Poison}, or a Common or Uncommon potion of your choice.

Enlarging the Facility. You can enlarge your Transmutation Vat into a Roomy facility by spending 2,000 GP. When you issue the Harvest order to a Roomy Transmutation Vat, you can expend two Common or Uncommon potions. If you do, your hireling produces two substances of your choice instead of one; the options can be different.

Foundry Note

Remove the required Common or Uncommon potion from your inventory when you issue the Harvest order. Leave the Harvest Item blank and grant the chosen result manually when the order finishes. A Roomy Transmutation Vat can use two qualifying potions and produce two chosen results.
Transmutation Vat.name: Transmutation Vat

Soup Kitchen.description:
Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Sheltering Hands

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Recruit

This kitchen prepares large quantities of food and serves it to hungry people.

Recruit: Kitchen Operation. When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, you instruct your hireling to operate the soup kitchen for 7 days. Ingredients cost you 50 GP. If you would lose a Bastion Defender or a hireling on the next roll on the Bastion Events table, someone who believes in your work steps into their place and takes over immediately. You don’t count as losing that Bastion Defender or hireling.

Traveling Snacks. After spending a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.items.Item.aunGoodberryChar]{Charm} allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGoodberry0]{Goodberry} once without expending a spell slot.

Foundry Note

Enter 50 GP as the cost when issuing the Recruit order. After the order finishes, track the replacement benefit manually for the next Bastion Event that would cause you to lose a Bastion Defender or hireling. Grant the Traveling Snacks Charm manually after a qualifying Long Rest.
Soup Kitchen.name: Soup Kitchen

Morgue.description:
Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Covenant of the Grave

Space: Cramped

Hirelings: 1

Order: Research

A morgue is a location where corpses are stored and studied. You can store up to four Small or Medium corpses in the Morgue.

Corpse Storage. As long as this facility’s hireling is present, each corpse stored in the Morgue is affected by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGentleRepo]{Gentle Repose} spell. If the facility lacks a hireling or a corpse is removed, the facility’s corpses or the removed corpse loses this protection until returned to a Morgue with a hireling.

Research: Cadaver Insights. When you issue the Research order to this facility, you instruct the facility’s hireling to carefully inspect the corpses. This work takes 7 days. The next time you speak with the hireling, the hireling can share the cause of death of each corpse present and answer one question you have for each corpse as though the hireling had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSpeakwithD]{Speak with Dead} spell on it.

Enlarging the Facility. You can enlarge your Morgue to a Roomy facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the Morgue can store up to twelve Small or Medium corpses and up to one Large corpse.
Morgue.name: Morgue

Lighthouse.description:
Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Seers of Sea and Sky

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Harvest

This tall lighthouse has rotating lenses that make its light visible from a significant distance, even in poor weather. Your hireling operates and maintains the machinery and ignites or douses the light as you direct.

Vision Charm. Time in your lighthouse inspires you to pierce the darkness. After spending a Long Rest in your Lighthouse, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgCharmOfDarkvi]{Charm of Darkvision} (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide).

Harvest: Illuminate Treasure. When you issue the Harvest order to this facility, you instruct the facility’s hireling to watch the surrounding area for lost or discarded valuables. The hireling watches for 7 days. At the end of that time, you can hire salvagers to retrieve treasures your hireling spotted. You must spend 100 GP to hire the salvagers, who return with treasure worth [[/award 1d4*100gp]].

Foundry Note

Leave the Harvest Item blank when issuing this order. After the order is complete, deduct the 100 GP salvager cost manually, then use the Award link above to determine and distribute the recovered treasure.
Lighthouse.name: Lighthouse

Entertainment Salon.description:
Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Bejeweled Conclave

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 2

Order: Research

This fancy salon boasts elegant wall hangings, comfortable reclining couches, and a well-stocked bar.

Open Pockets. Your eloquent hirelings convince others to pay a little more or to accept a little less. When you roll a die to determine how many Gold Pieces you pay or gain for a Bastion order or event, you can roll twice and take either result.

Research: Learn Secrets. When you issue the Research order to this facility, you direct the facility’s hirelings to entertain well-informed contacts and learn about a specific creature you name within 50 miles of your Bastion. After 7 days of work, the hirelings gain [[/r 1d4]] facts about the named creature that aren’t widely known and might be amusing, embarrassing, or useful. The hirelings also discover the creature’s power relative to yours (such as whether the creature’s CR is higher than, lower than, or the same as your level). At the DM’s discretion, you might receive limited or incorrect information about an exceptionally private or supernaturally disguised creature.
Entertainment Salon.name: Entertainment Salon

Planar Gateway.name: Planar Gateway
Planar Gateway.description:
Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Horizon Weavers; ability to use an Arcane Focus, a Holy Symbol, or a tool as a Spellcasting Focus

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Empower

The focus of this chamber is an inscribed stone archway filled with mist and strange lights. This archway can connect to other planes of existence.

Empower: Open Gate. When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct the facility’s hireling to tune the archway to a place on another plane of existence. Tuning the archway takes 7 days, at the end of which time the gateway opens. If you provide a diamond worth 5,000+ GP as part of the tuning, the gate connects to a place you specify on another plane, as with the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGate000000]{Gate} spell (for transport only, not to draw a specific creature through) and destroys the diamond. If you don’t provide a diamond or if a deity or another planar ruler blocks the intended gate from opening, determine the gate’s destination randomly on the Random Planar Destination table. In either case, the gateway remains open for 1 minute.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.tables.RollTable.aunRandomPlanadr rollable resultLabel="Destination" captionPosition=top]{Random Planar Destination}

Foundry Note

The Empower order tracks the 7-day tuning period. When it finishes, remove the 5,000 GP diamond manually if one was used. If no diamond was used, or the chosen destination is blocked, roll on the Random Planar Destination table above.
